title: Automatic Gunfire
blurb: Forty seconds of sustained fire at roughly ten rounds a second, with no gap anywhere long enough to cut on cleanly. That running time is unusual for a soundboard, and it changes what the file is for. Nobody presses this for a punchline. It exists as a bed, the layer you run underneath a scene at low level so the picture has something to sit on. Loop points are easy to find because the cadence barely varies from start to finish. Lift a short section if you want a hit, or fade the whole thing under a montage and forget about it.
origin: A generic sustained automatic gunfire recording, used as an ambience bed in edits.
